question: Ramniklal Solanki, who passed away in the United Kingdom in March 2020, was the founder of the newsweekly named:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Garavi Gujarat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Newspaper editor and journalist** **Ramniklal Solanki** was an **Indian-British.**
 
• The** Eastern Eye** newspaper was **founded** by him.
 
• He was also the **founder and editor-in-chief of Garavi Gujarat newsweekly** and **Asian Media Group (AMG).**
 
• The** Queen honored** him by bestowing upon him** an OBE in 1997 and a CBE in 2007.​**​

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Mirror:**

 
 
• Indian mirror was published in **Calcutta, West Bengal.**
 
• It was started by **Devendra Nath Tagore in 1862.**
